blocks.text: Why Chrome is the best browser for logistics work

Your day involves constant switching between TMS platforms, email, and tracking portals. Chrome offers the most compatibility with web-based logistics software. Most modern WMS and TMS providers build their interfaces for Chrome first. This means fewer bugs and faster load times for your critical dashboards.
Optimize your browser for high-volume tasks

You likely keep dozens of tabs open. This can slow down your Mac. Use the built-in memory saver to keep your active tabs fast. Go to Chrome > Settings > Performance and turn on Memory Saver. This frees up RAM from inactive tabs. It is a simple step that makes a large difference during busy shipping seasons.

items: Use [create a chrome profile on mac](/how-to/create-a-chrome-profile-in-chrome) to separate vendor accounts from internal tools.
Pin your most used tracking portals to your Dock using [how to add a website to the dock in chrome](/how-to/add-a-website-to-the-dock-in-chrome).
Clear your cache regularly if you notice loading errors on your TMS dashboard using [how to clear site data for one website in chrome](/how-to/clear-site-data-for-one-website-in-chrome).

blocks.text: Stop clicking around for basic actions. Master these shortcuts to save seconds on every task. Press ⌘ + T to open a new tab instantly. Press ⌘ + L to jump to the address bar. If you need to find text on a long BOL or manifest, use ⌘ + F to search the page. These small habits add up over a ten hour shift.

Logistics coordinators spend nearly 30 percent of their week on email. Use labels in Gmail to categorize incoming requests by status. Create labels for Urgent, Pending, and Completed. This keeps your inbox from becoming a bottleneck. If you use a shared mailbox, use [how to give delegate access in gmail on mac](/how-to/give-someone-access-to-your-mailbox-in-gmail) so your team can help with overflow.

Errors in data entry lead to shipping delays. When you pull data from a carrier portal, verify it before updating your system. Use [how to find and replace in google sheets](/how-to/find-and-replace-text-in-google-sheets) to quickly fix formatting issues in your reports. If you have duplicate entries, use [how to count unique values in google sheets](/how-to/count-unique-values-in-google-sheets) to ensure your inventory counts are accurate.

You handle sensitive customer and vendor information. Do not save passwords in plain text. Use the Google Password Manager or a dedicated manager. Check your extensions list often. Remove any that you do not recognize. Visit [how to install an extension in chrome](/how-to/install-an-extension-in-chrome) to learn how to manage them safely. Only keep extensions that provide direct value to your workflow.

Sometimes a page will not load. Do not panic. First, try refreshing the page with ⌘ + R. If that fails, open an incognito window using [how to open an incognito window in chrome](/how-to/open-an-incognito-window-in-chrome). If the page loads there, you likely have a bad extension or cache issue. Clear your browsing data with [how to clear browsing data chrome mac](/how-to/clear-browsing-data-in-chrome) to start fresh.

faq.question: Is Chrome the best browser for a logistics coordinator on a Mac?
faq.answer: Yes. Most logistics software is built for Chrome, ensuring fewer compatibility issues than Safari or Firefox.

faq.question: How can I speed up Chrome when I have many tabs open?
faq.answer: Enable Memory Saver in Chrome settings and close tabs you are not currently using. You can also use separate profiles for different tasks.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to help with my logistics emails?
faq.answer: Yes. You can hold the fn key to dictate emails directly into Gmail or your TMS text fields.

faq.question: What should I do if my TMS dashboard stops responding?
faq.answer: Try clearing the site data for that specific domain or opening it in an incognito window to see if an extension is causing the conflict.
